previewText: A local coffee spotlight, a seasonal home check, and the latest county market snapshot.
dannysNote:
Hey friends,

September is here, and the school-year rhythm is starting to feel a little more settled.

This week I pulled together a quick local business spotlight, a simple home check that fits the season, and a short look at what the latest county numbers are showing.

features.title: Cips Coffee Roasters
paragraphs: Cips Coffee Roasters brings a locally roasted coffee stop to Suwanee. If you enjoy discovering neighborhood businesses, take a look at their current coffees and shop details before your visit.

features.title: Give your HVAC filter a back-to-routine check.
paragraphs: With daily routines settling back in, this is a good week to check the filter and airflow around your heating and cooling system.
items: Inspect the filter and replace it if it is dirty or due under the manufacturer's schedule.
Keep supply and return vents clear of furniture, rugs, and curtains.
If you notice unusual noise, weak airflow, or moisture, contact a qualified HVAC professional.
